stage: After A/B executions and before C execution
change: Admit a narrow presence-only defaulting law for T17; continue rejecting a universal sentinel/defaulting abstraction.
reason: Requiring one explicit absence-only contract is not the same as requiring complete requirement interpretation. That local contract supplies both a discriminating pair and a side-effect oracle.
construction: Enumerate array/map times absent/present-undefined/present-zero; use a counting fallback to observe both returned value and lazy evaluation.
expectation_before_execution: Only absent invokes the fallback. Present undefined must stay undefined and must not invoke it.
scope_boundary: ECMAScript destructuring legitimately invokes fallback for present undefined; Python dict.get preserves present None but does not promise lazy evaluation of its default argument.
novelty_position: This remains an ordinary contract-derived equivalence-partition test; useful as a competing mechanism, not a new general research contribution.
